subject.title: Gateway memory growth due to repeated file read errors

question: Should this be fixed by correcting the scheduled producer prompts/paths only, or should the generic read tool treat directory paths as list operations?
rationale: Current source proves partial fixes and a remaining directory-as-file failure shape, but broadening read semantics is a model-facing tool contract change that should not be chosen by cleanup automation.

options.title: Fix producers only
options.body: Keep read as a file tool and correct the scheduler, heartbeat, or memory producer that asks for stale dates, memory-system/CORE.md, or directory paths.

options.title: Broaden read semantics
options.body: Make read return directory listings for directories, with explicit compatibility tests for models and callers that already expect read to fail on non-files.

recommendation.title: Fix producers only
recommendation.body: Keep read as a file tool and correct the scheduler, heartbeat, or memory producer that asks for stale dates, memory-system/CORE.md, or directory paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Their startup-context and heartbeat prompt history is the strongest current routing signal for scheduled memory-file producer behavior.
